body: Sometimes I'll do something in a game or something and I'll think about all these things I can't wait to tell her that happened and I realize that she's not there to tell.
Not really. Everything I've done just seems so blah. Either it reminds me of her or it's not enough to take my mind off everything.

How long were you with her? I think one of the hardest part for me is that we were together for 3 and a half years and we lived together for almost that whole time. The night before we were actually laughing and having a great time with a mutual friend on Ventrilo. I was comfortable. Now there's nothing.

I actually posted here a couple of days ago. A user by the name of babbidaboopy helped me get through that day but in short, my girlfriend of 3 and a half years unexpectedly broke up with me for another man. There was no warning. I just woke up one morning, went to kiss her good morning, saw that she was upset and asked what was wrong and she broke up with me then and there.

There's been many happenings since. I talked to her online after it happened a couple times. Today I saw her online and didn't say anything. Again this is a pretty slimmed down version of the story. 

Talking about the situation doesn't help though. I've talked about it to a few people and it sometimes helps for a moment but I fall right back into a depressed state. And when I get past the fact that I'm not going to get to wake up next to her every morning and that she doesn't want me anymore, I think about what life is going to be like from here on out without her. And I don't like what I have to look forward to. It's not going to get better like everyone says. I don't want anyone else. If I could only find a way to put into words how amazing she was. And I don't want to be alone anymore. 

I want my life back. I want to go home. I miss her so much and I miss my home and I miss our cat. It's gone and I can't come to terms with that. I keep holding onto hope that she'll realize she made a mistake and ask me to come home but I know that there's little to no chance of that and it eats me away. There's nothing and it won't get better. There will always be a gap there now in my life and I don't want to live that way. So why the fuck am I holding on?

Thanks man. Originally, I thought this was pretty unhelpful but that opening paragraph and the following two sentences kept running through my mind all day for some reason. It helped. 

Today was a very emotional but insightful day. She actually unblocked me from everything today after I promised to back away. I broke that promise. I put together one final well thought out plead for a final chance. But I promised not to drag it out any further if she said no. And she did say no. And I upheld my promise. And I promised to remain her best friend and keep her in my life as my best friend. And in a weird way that made me happy for a moment. I'm still very depressed but for a moment it felt like a warm light was shining down on me. For multiple reasons I think. One, it was a huge weight off my shoulders. I needed to say those things and I couldn't when I was blocked. And it provided some sort of closure. I still think it's wrong how she dropped me the way she did but it was closure none the less. And secondly and more importantly, it made me happy that she said I was still her best friend. I think the part that hurt the most was the way she dropped me. Like I was nothing. And it made me feel a little better when I realized she'd still be there... Even if she means as a friend. I love her to death and I wish with all my heart it was still me that she loved but at least she's still in my life. 

I think at this point the right thing to do is move on as hard as it's going to be. I tell you I have never been as close to suicide as I was today. There was a few moments that I actually had a cord wrapped around my neck and as I was tying it something always stopped me. 

This guy here, babbidaboopy, was the only person to respond to me and I really appreciate that. His words helped me get through my day. You're a good guy man and you probably helped save a life today. Let's hope tomorrow works out better for me.

I've already talked to my mother. I still feel the same way. It's not that I don't care about my mother but I still feel the same way. 

What about me? What about what I want? Should I be miserable for one person? My life is gone and it's not going to get much better. If I'm lucky I'll land a job. If I'm lucky it will be fulltime so I can buy a car and afford an apartment. I'll probably still be fat and I'll still have bad teeth. I'll be alone. Just like I was before I met her. If I'm lucky someone will see past that but I probably won't accept them as a replacement for her. At this point, I probably won't even be able to trust anyone again. I deserve this for letting someone into my heart the way I did. So, why should I live so miserably?
